summary: PASS — Per-qty Quote Summary table in PreviewPdfModal MP-Individual correctly groups each component at each qty tier (legacy parity). Validated on SA-260618-085911 (Tavens, MP, Pricing=Individual, Will-Call, 2 components: 'Shoe Box (1 Shoe Dagger)' & 'Boot Box 2', qtys 100/200). The bottom 'QUOTE SUMMARY' renders a TABLE with columns QTY | COMPONENTS | PRICE/SET | QUOTE TOTAL and one row per qty tier (data-testid='preview-summary-tier-100' and '...-200'). The old single 'Items (base sell)' lump is gone. Per-component sections above the summary remain unchanged (regression intact).

issues: Per-component 'TOTAL' column includes misc charges (e.g., Boot Box @qty100 shows $1,725.29 incl. $115 Clips), but new Quote Summary 'COMPONENTS' sum at the same qty uses base sell + freight + die + prepress only (excludes misc/clips), so visual sum of per-component TOTAL cells does not equal Quote Summary COMPONENTS/QUOTE TOTAL. Spec values in the request match what is displayed ($2,747.81 ≈ $2,747.80, $4,742.31), but customers may notice the asymmetry on the printed PDF. Informational only — not a regression.
